name: Let Me Help You sampler (blend noise prediction with the initial noise)
plain: Recovers the initial noise from the starting latent (x/σ_0, or with an initial latent subtracted for img2img, or a supplied noise) and, inside a step window, blends the model's noise prediction toward it before taking an Euler step; the model's denoised is rebuilt from the blended prediction. It can wrap another sampler through a model proxy instead of using its own Euler loop. Surprises: at assist_ratio 1 the model is not called at all in the window; and noise_prediction_scale is applied inside the proxy even when wrapping another sampler, although its tooltip says it has no effect there.
math:
Symbols: ε_0 recovered initial noise; d=(x−D)/σ; r assist_ratio; k noise_prediction_scale.
ε_0 = x/σ_0 (eps) or (x − z_0(1−σ_0))/σ_0 (flow, σ_0<1), times initial_noise_scale.
d' = blend(k·d, ε_0, r) (lerp: (1−r)k·d + r·ε_0); D' = x − σ·d'.
x' = lerp(D', x, σ'/σ) with σ' = σ + (σ_next−σ)·step_scale.

props.params: initial_noise_scale 1, noise_prediction_scale 1, step_scale 1, assist_ratio 0.25, assist_blend_mode lerp, blend_mode lerp, preview_mode adjusted, first/last_helping_step 0/−2, initial_latent_opt, initial_noise_opt, opt_sampler
